qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.lowering: The pinned single-vCPU alternatives patch replaces LOCK with a long-mode-ignored DS prefix. The exact live block uses the restartable signed bit-string read/write path; the static locked form retains its compare-exchange lowering.
admission.boundedRule: The measured RIP, complete eight-byte two-instruction block, signed ECX-to-RAX extension, DS-prefixed qword BTS, RSI base, and RAX index must all match. An adjacent RIP or changed base declines.

verification.focusedGate: All 67 DoryARM64Tier1JITTests pass, including the new live-patched BTS differential.
verification.dbtPCAndRunnerGate: 1,499 tests in 175 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Signed indices 0, 64, and -1 and both old-bit states match the interpreter for complete state, MOVSXD publication, CF, and memory.
verification.faultCoverage: A rejected final write restores complete block-entry state and memory, including the preceding MOVSXD destination.
verification.negativeCoverage: An adjacent RIP and a changed memory base both decline tier one.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. Exact-site absence establishes production use; aggregate and elapsed movements are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.

interpretation: The exact 6,614-hit alternatives-patched BTS block is absent from the candidate's capped live negative-cache sample. A05.2 remains open because 115,781 of 217,783 tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
The DS form is correct only because the pinned single-vCPU alternatives policy deliberately removes LOCK semantics at this exact site.
This evidence establishes no statistical performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
